content: Dual-axis charts widely flagged as misleading: crossover points are arbitrary, independent scale manipulation accentuates fake relationships, unclear series-axis mapping. Best practices when unavoidable: objective algorithm for scales, distinct colors, clear axis labels, limit to 2-3 series. Preferred alternatives: small multiples / stacked aligned panels sharing the x-axis, or index-normalize both series (e.g., 0-100). Sources: PolicyViz, Flourish, datarevelations, Y2Y paper.
